issues.description: The task (problem_statement.md) requires reporting the average area of municipalities per Landkreis, but the reference solution (solution_repository/aufgabe05.sql) selects the column 'kreis' twice and aliases the second occurrence as avg_flaeche (SELECT regierungsbezirk, kreis, kreis AS avg_flaeche). In other words, avg_flaeche in the solution contains the Kreis name, not the computed average of the flaeche column. This contradicts the problem text and will mislead students about the intended aggregate expression (AVG(flaeche)).
issues.suggestedFix: Replace the incorrect reuse of the 'kreis' column with an aggregate over the flaeche column and keep the requested columns. For example: SELECT regierungsbezirk, kreis, AVG(flaeche) AS avg_flaeche FROM Gemeinde GROUP BY regierungsbezirk, kreis ORDER BY kreis; Ensure the avg_flaeche column is computed as AVG(flaeche) so it matches the problem statement.
